Header: Tuta absoluta In Sinhala – (Thakkali gedi ha pathra kaninna”; In Tamil –Thakkali illai-kai surangamaki)

Prevention: Plant seedlings free from infestation of the pest.
Destroy plant residues of previous season before planting.
Monitoring: Monitor adult moths using pheromone traps or yellow sticky traps.
Look for larvae feeding galleries on leaves from the beginning of planting.
Look for frass near pedicel of immature/ matured fruits.
Direct Control: Remove and burn infested leaves/fruits regularly.
Use light traps/ pheromone traps for mass trapping of adult moths.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Use only in polytunnels to avoid bee toxicity
Mainly act by ingestion/ has contact action too.
